findings.reason: with only §4 declared as the wait, a dispatch may start §8 after the drain work and find no auto-promoted runs and no obligations list to collapse, producing a gate that measures an empty population.
findings.text: `plan-section-depends-on` gives `s8` only `s4`, while §8's deliverable is literally "what is left to a coordinator after §6 and §7" and its done-when counts twelve runs of which nine qualify "under §6", so §8 cannot be measured before §6 and §7 land

findings.reason: without a control arm (the census replayed over the baseline week reproducing the recorded 19.6-minute median) and without the bounds being pass/fail, a broken census reports improvement and the plan's closing evidence is unfalsifiable.
findings.text: §10's done-when declares no negative control and states that a measure missing its bound (median under 30 minutes, five delivered runs, 30-minute queue wait) "is a complete result", so the only live-fleet node cannot fail on the figures it exists to prove

findings.reason: the endpoint rule puts the reuse map in the node brief; a plan that names a module commits a layout guess that a wrong guess turns into a wrong write fence for every node it reaches.
findings.text: each section closes with "Write paths:" naming target modules and test files (`reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py`, `reckon/crew/merge.py`, `reckon/crew/station.py`, `tests/test_the_promotion_queue_serves_fairly.py`, and so on), and §5/§6/§9/§11 defer to "the module the design review names", so the plan fixes a guess about file layout and cannot resolve its own declared scope

findings.reason: a worker must choose between the section's first test case and its substance rule, and the result decides whether the 49 blocked runs are repaired or stay blocked.
findings.text: §5 says classification reads the base from the run's pointer, yet lists "a base that is not an ancestor of its head" as a substance difference that stays blocked, which is exactly the one-mistyped-character echo case the same done-when requires to become deliverable; "the base" is never disambiguated as the echo or the pointer

rubric_items.naming: pass — test filenames follow the repository's existing phrase-per-test convention (`tests/test_a_batch_...`) and carry no ticket, sprint or version tag; §5's prose phrase "the manifest classifier module the design review names" is an implementation-scope gap, scored under reasoning.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — every section from §2 to §11 prescribes code paths in a "Write paths:" sentence, which is the node brief's reuse map, not the plan's endpoint.
